status: PROPOSAL - thresholds set on one document family (5 documents); generalisation NOT EVALUATED

word_recall_min.unit: fraction of PDF word tokens (after furniture exclusion) found in the K1 page text

numeric_recall_min.unit: fraction of PDF numeric tokens (after furniture exclusion) found in the K1 page text

numeric_novel_max.unit: count of K1 numeric tokens that do not occur anywhere on the PDF page; a count above this value warns

min_page_words.unit: PDF word tokens needed on a page before word recall is judged

empty_page_min_words.unit: PDF word tokens on a page that make an empty K1 page a warning

margin_band.unit: fraction of page height at top and bottom searched for repeated lines (same value as the pipeline filter margin_band)

frequency.unit: fraction of pages of a document on which a margin line (digits masked) must appear to count as furniture

min_pages.unit: pages a document needs before repeated margin lines are used

margin_frequency.unit: fraction of pages of a document in whose top/bottom margin band a line (digit runs masked) must appear to count as furniture even when it is not repeated on `frequency` of all pages (footer of a sub-report inside a longer PDF); A-416, set on development data

margin_min_pages.unit: pages; a margin line must appear in the margin band of at least this many pages (and margin_frequency of the pages) to count as furniture

page_counter_patterns.unit: regular expressions (case-insensitive) for page counters such as 'Page 3 of 12', 'Page: 1 of 1', '9 | P a g e', 'Page | 2'; a line that matches at one of the first/last page_counter_edge_lines lines is furniture (A-416)

page_counter_edge_lines.unit: non-empty lines at the top and at the bottom of the page text searched for page counters

page_number_max_digits.unit: digits; a line that is only a number of at most this many digits at the first/last line or in a margin band counts as page number

block_edge_lines.unit: non-empty text lines at the top and at the bottom of the page searched for a repeated header/footer block that lies outside the margin band (title block of a sub-report); A-432, set on development data

block_min_pages.unit: pages; a line (digit runs masked) must stand within the block_edge_lines top or bottom lines of at least this many pages (and block_frequency of the pages) to count as block furniture

block_frequency.unit: fraction of the pages of a document; see block_min_pages

hierarchical_pattern.unit: regular expression for a line-leading outline number such as '16.3 Casing' (each part 1-2 digits, so '9.625 in.' is not matched)

flat_pattern.unit: regular expression for a line-leading list number with a closing dot or parenthesis such as '1. Daily reports' or '2) Final log'

min_series.unit: line-leading numbers with the same parent (all but the last dotted part) and different last parts that must stand on the PDF page before they count as list/outline markers; a single number at a line start is never one

marker_severity.unit: severity (WARN or INFO) of FIDELITY_ENUMERATOR_MARKERS_NOT_KEPT; WARN restores the pre-B3 flagging of pages that lost list/outline numbers (A-445, owner direction D2: no mass WARN->INFO; no sub-class was shown harmless on viewed crops: appendix numbers, step numbers and section numbers are references)

following_words.unit: words after the number that must stand next to each other, in order, in the K1 page text (the item text was kept, only its marker is missing)

max_listed_tokens.unit: missing/novel tokens copied into signal evidence per category
